name: grouped-data-table-01
title: Grouped Data Table
description: Reusable single-level grouped table with expansion, per-group previews, search, filters and matching record counts.

files.content:
import type { GroupedDataTableLabels } from "./grouped-data-table-types";
export const groupedDataTableZhLabels: GroupedDataTableLabels = {
    title: "分组表格",
    search: "搜索记录",
    searchPlaceholder: "搜索记录…",
    expandAll: "全部展开",
    collapseAll: "全部收起",
    expandGroup: (label) => `展开 ${label}`,
    collapseGroup: (label) => `收起 ${label}`,
    showMore: (count, label) => `显示 ${label} 的另外 ${count} 条`,
    showLess: (label) => `收起 ${label} 的更多记录`,
    results: (matching, total) => `${matching} 条匹配，共 ${total} 条记录`,
    clearFilters: "清空筛选",
    empty: "暂无记录",
    noResults: "没有匹配的记录",
    loading: "正在加载记录。",
    error: "记录加载失败，请重试。",
    retry: "重试",
    ungrouped: "未分组",
    density: "表格密度",
    comfortable: "舒适",
    compact: "紧凑",
    customizeColumns: "自定义列",
    dragToReorder: "拖动调整列顺序",
    reorderAndToggle: "调整列顺序与显隐",
    showColumn: (label) => `显示 ${label} 列`,
    reorderColumn: (label) => `调整 ${label} 列顺序`,
};
export const groupedDataTableEnLabels: GroupedDataTableLabels = {
    title: "Grouped table",
    search: "Search records",
    searchPlaceholder: "Search records…",
    expandAll: "Expand all",
    collapseAll: "Collapse all",
    expandGroup: (label) => `Expand ${label}`,
    collapseGroup: (label) => `Collapse ${label}`,
    showMore: (count, label) => `Show ${count} more in ${label}`,
    showLess: (label) => `Show less in ${label}`,
    results: (matching, total) => `${matching} matching of ${total} records`,
    clearFilters: "Clear filters",
    empty: "No records yet",
    noResults: "No matching records",
    loading: "Loading records.",
    error: "Unable to load records. Try again.",
    retry: "Retry",
    ungrouped: "Ungrouped",
    density: "Table density",
    comfortable: "Comfortable",
    compact: "Compact",
    customizeColumns: "Customize columns",
    dragToReorder: "Drag to reorder columns",
    reorderAndToggle: "Reorder and toggle columns",
    showColumn: (label) => `Show ${label} column`,
    reorderColumn: (label) => `Reorder ${label} column`,
};
